LightningComponentBundle.description: Sends the logged-in user to an external URL with their Account HUB ID added as a URL parameter.

property.name: destinationUrl
property.label: Destination URL
property.description: Where users are sent. The HUB ID parameter is added automatically.

property.name: paramName
property.label: Parameter Name
property.description: Name of the URL parameter that carries the HUB ID.

property.name: disableRedirect
property.label: Pause Redirect
property.description: Shows the generated link instead of redirecting. Use for testing.
